issues.jp_before: 疲[つか]れた{ので|node-because}、ソファー{に|ni-target}座[すわ]っ{て|te-sequence}テレビ{を|o-object}見[み]ました。
issues.problem: Distractor で: 'ソファーで座ってテレビを見た' is heard colloquially (で for the place of the whole activity), so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor で with が.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{が|ga-subject}泣[な]いていること{に|ni-target}誰[だれ]{も|mo-total-negation}気[き]づきませんでした。
issues.problem: The が marks the subject inside the nominalized clause (…こと), so the skill is ga-sub-clause, not ga-subject.
issues.action: Changed the slot skill to ga-sub-clause.

issues.jp_before: 急[いそ]いで走[はし]った{ので|node-because}、七時[しちじ]{の|no-possessive}バス{に|ni-target}間[ま]に合[あ]いました。
issues.problem: Distractor で: '七時のバスで間に合いました' (I made it on time by taking the 7:00 bus) is natural and fits the context almost as well.
issues.action: Replaced distractor で with が.

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]ども{は|wa-topic}お母[かあ]さん{の|no-possessive}手[て]{に|ni-target}しっかりつかまっていました。
issues.problem: The English gives the child a gender ('his') that the Japanese does not state.
issues.action: Changed 'his mother's hand' to 'their mother's hand'.

issues.jp_before: 疲[つか]れた父[ちち]{が|ga-subject}壁[かべ]{に|ni-target}寄[よ]りかかっています。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot was missing an equally natural alternative: は works just as well here.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{が|ga-sub-clause}投[な]げたボール{が|ga-subject}窓[まど]{に|ni-target}当[あ]たりました。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot inside the relative clause was missing the の alternative (弟の投げたボール is just as natural).

issues.jp_before: 朝[あさ]の散歩[さんぽ]{で|de-place}、近所[きんじょ]{の|no-possessive}犬[いぬ]{に/と|ni-target}出会[であ]いました。
issues.problem: The の in 朝の散歩 is a real particle but had no slot, which breaks the mark-every-particle rule.
issues.action: Marked it as {の|no-possessive} and moved f from 2 to 3.
